cause_quote: The introducing diff set paired rows to `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);` and each side to `grid-template-columns: 42px 16px minmax(max-content, 1fr);`, allowing long text tracks to extend beyond their half of the row even with wrapping enabled.
user_saw: Long lines in Review’s split diff crossed the divider and overlapped the opposite side’s text even with Wrap lines enabled.
summary: The fix gives split rows shared columns that fit the available width when wrapping is enabled and expand for horizontal scrolling when wrapping is disabled.
reasoning: The feature commit replaced the previous unified-only render path with a selectable split renderer and introduced the CSS that caused the overlap. The same paired-row and text-track sizing rules were still present in the stylesheet immediately before the fix.
